name: safe-things-mcp
description: Local MCP server for Things 3 on macOS: full reads plus Inbox-only writes via the Things URL scheme, with a propose/confirm safety layer and undo.

things_auth_token.title: Things Authorization Token
things_auth_token.description: Get this from Things -> Settings -> General -> Manage. Required for any mutating tool.

allow_applescript.title: Allow AppleScript operations
allow_applescript.description: Enables delete-to-Trash, reorder, and AI tagging via AppleScript. Triggers a one-time macOS automation permission prompt.

auto_confirm.title: Auto-confirm proposed writes
auto_confirm.description: Skips the confirm step for propose_* tools. Destructive and bulk operations always require explicit confirmation regardless of this setting.
